senses.gloss: सेवा- + अवलम्ब सेवा- + अवलम्ब, adj. depending on the service of..., Bhartṛ. 1, 66.
सेवक- + उत्तम सेवक- + उत्तम, m. an excellent servant, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1435.
† शेव् शेव्, i. 1, Ātm. To worship (cf. सेव्).

सेव् सेव् (akin to सप्), i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. To follow, to apply one's self to, Man. 6, 35.
 2. To study, MBh. 3, 27.
 3. To practise, Man. 6, 29; to do, Ragh. 17, 49.
 4. To enjoy, Hit. i. d. 172, M.M. (cherish); Pañc. v. d. 24; carnally, Man. 8, 365; to love, Hit. 87, 1.
 5. To inhabit, MBh. 3, 2402.
 6. To tarry somewhere (with acc.), Man. 4, 131.
 7. To frequent, Pañc. i. d. 9; Lass. 39, 7; to search, Vikr. d. 41.
 8. To stand at, to guard, Hit. 98, 18.
 9. To serve, to gratify, Ragh. 11, 11.
 10. To honour, Man. 7, 38; to worship, Hit. ii. d. 27. सेवित,
 1. Pursued, used.
 2. Protected.
 3. Frequented, Hit. i. d. 150, M.M.
 --Comp.[]
 --Comp.
 --Caus. To worship, Hit. ii. d. 33.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
 1. To practise, Mṛcch. 35, 6.
 2. To employ for smearing with, Ṛt. 6, 12 (v. r.).
 3. To enjoy, Vikr. 67, 3; MBh. 3, 16564.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To practise, Man. 11, 174. समासेरित, Served.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To apply one's self to, to practise, MBh. 2, 159.
 2. To perform, MBh. 13, 7567.
 3. To enjoy, MBh. 3, 15382.
 4. To serve, to honour, Man. 4, 133.
 5. To haunt, Pañc. i. d. 279. उपसेवित, Smeared, Rām. 2, 100, 33.
 --With अभ्युप अभि-उप, To observe, MBh. 3, 13432.
 --With समुप सम्-उप, To enjoy, Rām. 1, 35, 23.
 --With नि नि, षेव्,
 1. To pursue, to attach one's self to, Hit. i. d. 209, M.M.
 2. To practise, Man. 4, 155.
 3. To employ, Śiś. 9, 68.
 4. To enjoy, MBh. 3, 11877.
 5. To inhabit, Pañc. 31, 1; Rām. 1, 31, 21.
 6. To observe, Śāk. d. 26.
 7. To attend, Man. 9, 300.
 --With सम् सम्, To worship, Kir. 18, 24.

शेव शेव,
 I. m.
 1. A snake (vb. शी)
 2. Happiness.
 II. acc. वम्, indecl. Hail, homage, an exclamation or salutation addressed to the deities.
 III. n., and f. वा, The penis (cf. शेप).

सेवा सेव् + आ, f.
 1. Service, Man. 4, 5; Vikr. d. 42.
 2. Servitude, Hit. i. d. 136, M.M.
 3. Practice, Rājat. 5, 280.
 4. Worship, Bhag. 4, 34.
 5. Homage, Rājat. 5, 154.
 --Comp.
शेवधि शेवधि i. e. शेव-धा (cf. निधि), m. A treasure, Mālat. 103, 10; also सेवधि, q. cf.

सेवधि सेवधि, also शेवधि, q. cf., [] m.
 1. A divine treasure owned by Kuvera, the god of wealth.
 2. A treasure, Man. 2, 114.

शेवाल शेवाल, शैवल and शैवाल शैवा̆ल, m. n. The green moss-like substance growing on the surface of water, duck-weed (Vallisneria? cf. शेपाल and शैव), Pañc. 188, 12 (शैवल); Śāk. d. 19 (शैवल); Rām. 2, 46, 32, Seramp. (शैवाल).

A. सेव् + अक,
 I. adj. Servile, dependent,
 II. m. A servant, Pañc. 217, 25; Rājat. 5, 51 (read देव सेवकः, ‘O king, a servant of the minister Śūra, hold by him like a son...’).
 B. i. e. सिव् + अक, A sack.
 --Comp.

सेवन सेवन, i. e. सिव् and सेव् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Sewing, stitching.
 2. A sack.
 3. Following, being addicted to, haunting, Pañc. 241, 1; practising, Hit. ii. d. 32; using, 217, 23.
 4. Enjoying, dallying with, Man. 11, 178.
 5. Service, Rājat. 5, 368.
 II. f. नी, A needle.
 --Comp.

सेवित्व सेवित्व, i. e. सेविन् + त्व, n.
 1. Staying, inhabiting, Bhag. 13, 10.
 2. Serving, devotion.

सेविन् सेव् + इन्, adj.
 1. Pursuing, practising.
 2. Serving.
 3. Honouring, Man. 7, 38.
 4. Dwelling, Vikr. 64, 1.
 --Comp.

सेव्यता सेव्य + ता (vb. सेव्), f.
 1. State of being honoured, Ṛt. 1, 2; Hit. ii. d. 89 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1304).
 2. Rank, eminence, worth, Mālat. 46, 10.
